duplicate-native-readers.responsibility: Construct the admitted fingerprint reader and metadata-only source-state probe
duplicate-native-readers.reason: The factories select native implementations behind Ame ports; availability and analysis policy stay in application owners.
duplicate-native-readers.lifetime: One stateless probe per inspection; fingerprint leases retain the existing shared background admission and held source until publication.
duplicate-native-readers.replacement: Replace these two factories through ExactContentReader and SourceStateProbe while retaining lease and source-safety contracts.

organization-catalog-composition.responsibility: Open lane-scoped catalog handles for duplicate review and virtual organization
organization-catalog-composition.reason: These named factories select storage and the existing validated catalog session; callers use repository ports and adapters retain transactions.
organization-catalog-composition.lifetime: The caller owns each handle; duplicate member reads release it before source inspection, and organization operations retain their transaction boundaries.
organization-catalog-composition.replacement: Replace catalog-session construction together with the repository implementations without changing validation or operation policy.

organization-batch-composition.responsibility: Acquire a bounded organization-selection session and its repository
organization-batch-composition.reason: The constructor acquires a permit and shared cancellation control, then selects the batch adapter; later operations consume OrganizationBatchRepository.
organization-batch-composition.lifetime: ActiveSelection owns the repository and capacity permit; failed construction drops the permit, and close signals cancellation before joined retirement.
organization-batch-composition.replacement: Substitute the batch repository at this constructor while preserving permit, cancellation and close ownership.

catalog-session-composition.responsibility: Shared validated catalog session, validation flights and lane-scoped connection factories
catalog-session-composition.reason: These resource hosts retain adapter-owned identity/schema proof while application owns shared waiters, invalidation, backoff and foreground-scan exclusion.
catalog-session-composition.lifetime: One shared validation owner per catalog path; failed or invalidated flights wake their original waiters, and current-session identity guards scan acquisition and stale replacement.
catalog-session-composition.replacement: Replace the proof and connection factories together with persistence while retaining shared validation, scan protection, lane selection and caller-owned connections.

catalog-reclamation-composition.responsibility: Select the catalog maintenance repository and native available-capacity probe
catalog-reclamation-composition.reason: The factories construct path-scoped or stateless adapters behind existing maintenance operations and the capacity port; execution and retry policy consume the ports.
catalog-reclamation-composition.lifetime: The maintenance value holds its path only; each adapter operation retires its connection, permit and interruption registration. Capacity queries retain no handle or output pointer.
catalog-reclamation-composition.replacement: Replace the factory selections and port implementations while preserving operation identity, maintenance admission, source safety and terminal publication.

catalog-read-source-composition.responsibility: Select the metadata-only source-state probe for catalog root availability
catalog-read-source-composition.reason: The factory selects the native implementation through SourceStateProbe; root projection consumes Ame availability evidence.
catalog-read-source-composition.lifetime: A stateless probe is selected after preview reconciliation and recovery scheduling; it reads root metadata only and retains no source handle.
catalog-read-source-composition.replacement: Replace the source-state factory through its port without moving snapshot projection, read retry or preview recovery ownership.

storage-composition.responsibility: Select settings persistence, preview-cache capabilities and OS default locations
storage-composition.reason: Only these factories select native implementations; application retains validation, transition admission, budgets and activation policy.
storage-composition.lifetime: Settings callers own the original connection scope; cleanup and recovery retain observed namespace guards through completion, while default-path selection acquires no resource.
storage-composition.replacement: Replace the settings/cache ports and OS directory selection without changing restart policy, overlap checks or pending-root retirement.

classification-execution-composition.responsibility: Own the native dispatcher, lazily acquired feature cache and encoder residency resources
classification-execution-composition.reason: These exact host types and acquisition methods connect the existing repository, encoder and execution ports without owning SQL or native inference protocols.
classification-execution-composition.lifetime: One process runtime retains its catalog and executor; feature/matcher acquisition is lazy, borrowed resources stay inside that host, and failed retirement prevents replacement.
classification-execution-composition.replacement: Replace the host concrete resource types and native factory together while retaining dispatcher, feature, encoder, source and retirement contracts.

classification-source-composition.responsibility: Select guarded image and exact-content readers under the shared background admission
classification-source-composition.reason: These entrypoints acquire native resources and delegate analysis/verification to existing Ame repository and source-reader ports.
classification-source-composition.lifetime: Content admission precedes catalog acquisition and outlives source retirement; exact-reader leases retain admission and namespace handles through publication or rollback.
classification-source-composition.replacement: Replace the selected guarded readers through ClassificationImageReader and ExactContentReader while preserving claim revalidation, source retirement and shared admission.

classification-vocabulary-composition.responsibility: Select the bundled managed classification vocabulary through its Ame contract
classification-vocabulary-composition.reason: The factory owns the concrete vocabulary selection; discovery consumes repository ports and the vocabulary metadata/read contract.
classification-vocabulary-composition.lifetime: The stateless factory runs only when the current pass needs vocabulary; the pass retains its vocabulary and naming contexts until invalidation, completion or release.
classification-vocabulary-composition.replacement: Replace this factory and managed vocabulary implementation while preserving catalog revisions, naming contexts, cancellation and the notification-scoped pass lifecycle.

classification-installation-composition.responsibility: Select installation persistence, the pinned native model package and OS model storage
classification-installation-composition.reason: Three stateless factories bind Ame installation and prepared-resource contracts; configuration, recovery and publication consume those contracts.
classification-installation-composition.lifetime: Construction opens no database or model; each operation retains its transaction or verified file/namespace guards, and the application installation owner spans preparation and publication.
classification-installation-composition.replacement: Replace persistence or the model package behind these contracts while preserving durable intent generations, atomic selection, fixed artifact verification and guarded retirement before publication.

preview-store-composition.responsibility: Own the selected native preview store and operation-scoped cache namespace
preview-store-composition.reason: The resource host selects a store only under generation or reclamation access and keeps namespace identity across their bounded capacity handoff.
preview-store-composition.lifetime: The operation retains its namespace guard; each acquired access selects the current store, while registry inventory runs outside the short publication lock.
preview-store-composition.replacement: Replace namespace and store construction together while preserving access-first selection, shared current accounting, invalidation and guarded namespace retirement.

viewer-source-composition.responsibility: Acquire and retain the native source and namespace guard for one bounded viewer lease
viewer-source-composition.reason: The exact guard factory and private lease field are a resource boundary; request, catalog and capacity policy remain outside the admitted edges.
viewer-source-composition.lifetime: Catalog authority is checked before and after native acquisition; the lease releases its file/ancestor guard before returning process source capacity.
viewer-source-composition.replacement: Replace guarded native acquisition while preserving no-follow/no-recall behavior, complete namespace retention, stale-catalog rejection and the opaque bridge close contract.

scan-source-composition.responsibility: Select pinned source discovery, publication namespaces, metadata-only revalidation and media inspection for a foreground scan
scan-source-composition.reason: Only named resource factories choose concrete adapters; scan admission, traversal, validation and publication consume Ame ports and domain values.
scan-source-composition.lifetime: The configured-root proof outlives borrowed directory cursors; publication namespaces retain root and ancestor bindings through admission or publication, while the stateless probe grants no namespace authority.
scan-source-composition.replacement: Replace native selections through their ports while preserving root acquisition order, no-follow/no-recall admission, held-handle evidence, cancellation and bounded traversal.

preview-source-composition.responsibility: Select admitted preview-source capabilities and inspection of already-open media
preview-source-composition.reason: The factories expose Ame contracts while initial read admission, source mismatch handling and publication policy keep their existing application owners.
preview-source-composition.lifetime: Initial source reading follows catalog/root admission; fresh publication protection follows decode revalidation and retains source/ancestor guards through catalog publication or rollback.
preview-source-composition.replacement: Replace source and media-inspection selections through their ports without reopening the decoder path or changing identity/revision checks, no-recall admission, acquisition points or drop order.

incremental-source-composition.responsibility: Select publication-bound source access and guarded media inspection
incremental-source-composition.reason: Incremental changes, preview reconciliation, indexed startup and metadata recovery consume source contracts while retaining their lease, evidence and catalog-publication policy.
incremental-source-composition.lifetime: The admitted root and ancestor namespace remains held through preparation, source revalidation and publication or rollback; media readers retain their original open and drop scopes.
incremental-source-composition.replacement: Replace the source and inspector port implementations without reopening mutable absolute paths, changing no-recall admission or altering queue authority and transaction order.

indexed-recovery-composition.responsibility: Select the optional platform search index behind SearchIndex
indexed-recovery-composition.reason: Only the named factory selects Windows Search; the recovery worker consumes catalog ports and indexed preparation owns hint admission.
indexed-recovery-composition.lifetime: The stateless index is selected inside the admitted Recovery worker after root revalidation; its read owns and retires the COM apartment and cursor.
indexed-recovery-composition.replacement: Replace the SearchIndex implementation without changing recovery selection, cancellation, bounded hint reads, source verification or journal failure fallback.

root-location-composition.responsibility: Select metadata-only directory identity discovery behind the held namespace contract
root-location-composition.reason: Only the named factory selects the Windows locator; application recovery scheduling and catalog publication consume Ame contracts.
root-location-composition.lifetime: The located value retains its original directory and ancestor guards through identity revalidation, the recovery transaction and terminal worker retirement.
root-location-composition.replacement: Replace the locator and PublicationNamespace implementation without changing no-recall admission, cancellation, catalog generation checks or atomic recovery publication.

synchronization-catalog-resources.responsibility: Bind the validated worker session and own the retained poll connection and cleanup connection factory
synchronization-catalog-resources.reason: The named resource owners acquire and retire native proof/connections; scheduling, cleanup and status projection consume persistence ports.
synchronization-catalog-resources.lifetime: One path-bound poll connection is checked out at a time; worker factories retain the existing shared proof, refresh through the scan-protected owner and close outside transition locks.
synchronization-catalog-resources.replacement: Replace these session and connection resources together while preserving epoch binding, proof identity, worker handoff, retained WAL and joined retirement.

synchronization-source-state-composition.responsibility: Select the metadata-only root-availability probe through SourceStateProbe
synchronization-source-state-composition.reason: Only the named factory chooses LocalSourceState; the synchronization runtime consumes Ame availability evidence.
synchronization-source-state-composition.lifetime: The stateless probe is selected at the existing root observation point and retains no source handle or content reader.
synchronization-source-state-composition.replacement: Replace the probe through SourceStateProbe while preserving no-recall metadata inspection and existing availability projection.
